critical_code_review_comments: useNovaVoice.ts correctly uses single persistent useAudioPlayer(null) + player.replace(source) + 150ms setTimeout before play — matches expo-audio recommended imperative pattern.
Web path uses `data:audio/mpeg;base64,...` URI (browser-safe, avoids File API which isn't available in web).

Native path uses new expo-file-system v19 API: `new Directory(Paths.cache, 'nova')` + `dir.create({intermediates:true})` + `new File(dir, 'tts_<ts>.mp3')` + `file.write(b64, {encoding:'base64'})`. No deprecated FileSystem.EncodingType references remain.
server.py /api/nova/daily correctly caches by (device_id, date) in db.daily_briefs with upsert; force=true bypasses cache. Fallback brief if LLM JSON parse fails is sensible.
server.py still under 700 lines; all Mongo reads use `{'_id': 0}` projection consistently.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Nova not speaking, just chatbot replies'. Root cause was in useNovaVoice.ts: (1) code used deprecated FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 (removed in expo-file-system v19) throwing 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Base64)' before audio could load, (2) reactive useAudioPlayer(sourceObj) pattern was unreliable across web/native for source swaps. Fix applied by main agent: (a) migrated to expo-file-system v19 File/Directory imperative API with {encoding:'base64'} string option, (b) switched to single persistent useAudioPlayer(null) + player.replace(source) + player.play() with 150ms warm-up delay, (c) web platform uses data:audio/mpeg;base64 URI (no File API needed). Verified: no console errors on Nova modal open, no 'speak failed' logs, TTS backend returns valid MP3 (ID3 or 0xFFxx sync header). Actual audible playback must be verified on-device.
